csi_division: Division 23 - Heating, Ventilating, and Air Conditioning (HVAC)
question_summary: Subcontractor requests approval to substitute a fan-coil-based alternate air handling unit in lieu of the specified packaged rooftop AHU per Section 23 05 00, citing lead time concerns, with no anticipated cost or schedule impact.
proposed_solution: Substitute a fan-coil-based alternate air handling unit for the specified packaged rooftop AHU, with no cost or schedule adjustment anticipated.
deadline_text: Please respond within five business days so we can place the order.
routing_rationale: The request concerns substitution of an HVAC air handling unit governed by Section 23 05 00, making it a mechanical discipline matter best reviewed by the Mechanical Engineer of Record.
